title_sq: Triblex ne Shitje, Swan Lake Residence Liqeni i Farkes
description_sq:
Triblex ne shitje ne residencen Swan Lake tek Liqeni i Farkes
Vecantia e tipologjise se triplekseve ne residencen Swan Lake jane pishinat ne tarracen e shtepise tuaj, duke e kthyer ate ne nje ambient unik per t'u relaksuar. Hapesirat jane te bollshme dhe te shfrytezuara maksimalisht, te pershtatshme per nje familje te madhe.
Informacion:
Siperfaqe totale: 210 m2
Siperfaqe e perbashket 4.14 m2
Siperfaqe fizike 206.69 m2
Kati perdhe organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies, 1 tualet, verande dhe pishine. Kati i pare organizohet ne 2 dhoma gjumi, njera me garderobe, 1 tualet dhe 1 ballkon. Kati i dyte organizohet ne 1 dhime gjumi + garderobe, 1 tualet, 1 ballkon dhe 1 depo. 
Per informacion te detajuar dhe nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
title_en: Triblex for sale, Swan Lake Residence Lake Farkes
description_en: Triplex for sale in the Swan Lake residence at Farka Lake The highlight of the triplex typology in the Swan Lake residence are the swimming pools on the terrace of your house, turning it into a unique environment to relax. The spaces are spacious and fully utilized, suitable for a large family. Information: Total area: 210 m2 Common area 4.14 m2 Physical area 206.69 m2 The ground floor is organized in a living room with a kitchen and dining area, 1 toilet, veranda and swimming pool. The first floor is organized into 2 bedrooms, one with a wardrobe, 1 bathroom and 1 balcony. The second floor is organized into 1 bedroom + wardrobe, 1 toilet, 1 balcony and 1 storage room. For detailed information and a visit to the property, contact us.
